title: Mummer’s wire
html_source:
“Mummer’s wire” is Stephen’s telegraph sent to Buck Mulligan and Haines waiting in The Ship. Mummer, because Stephen has been mum about it.
The wire read, “The sentimentalist is he who would enjoy without incurring the immense debtorship for a thing done'” This is a quote cribbed (stolen) out of “The Ordeal of Richard Feverel: A History of Father and son.” by George Meredith.

http://archive.org/stream/ordealrichardfe05meregoog#page/n270/mode/2up
